notes_for_editor: No build date, builder, staffing or fire history found in the sources read. Access not established: the brief lists it as unknown and the Register only says the state still owns the tower, so no access key is set. The Register text reads still owner by the state (sic); the story paraphrases it. The site visit is written 3/5/22 in the Register and the story quotes it as logged, since the date order is not certain. Elevation: Register 622 ft, Landforms 611 ft; Register used. The do-not-climb and ask-the-Division advice in the story is the editor's recommendation; the Register says nothing on either.
